verdict.rationale: Channel3, a product-data API rather than an agent, documents an official MCP server with a dedicated overview page. It names supported agent clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode), and its 'Shopping Agent with MCP' guide says it works without code or an API key. Missing for 10: detail on the MCP tools exposed and on setup/transport, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.trychannel3.com/mcp-overview
Connect Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or OpenCode.
You can use it without writing any code, and without an API key.
